data.name: Pontoon Boat
data.headline: 1-4 Hour options • Ages 18+ • Up to 10 people
data.description: Offering comfortable, spacious, and smooth rides, the pontoon boat rentals accommodate up to 10 passengers or 1492 pounds. This vessel is great for large families and groups.
data.highlights:
-Plush seating
-Partial shade
-Life vests included
-All boats are required to stay within the bay
data.group_size: 10 passengers as long as weight does not exceed 1492lbs

meeting_point.address: 1404 W. Vacation Way San Diego, CA US 92109

data.what_is_included:
Operational and safety instructions (all drivers must be at least 18 years old with a valid drivers license)
Life vests
what_is_included_items: Operational and safety instructions (all drivers must be at least 18 years old with a valid drivers license)
data.what_is_not_included:
A Driver, renters operate the vessel themselves. It is very easy and training is provided!
Docking lines
No beaching or swimming at any time
what_is_not_included_items: A Driver, renters operate the vessel themselves. It is very easy and training is provided!
No beaching or swimming at any time
data.what_to_bring:
Bring the credit card used to make the reservation and your matching Drivers License
Beverages and food if desired
what_to_bring_items: Bring the credit card used to make the reservation and your matching Drivers License
data.cancellation_notes:
#24 hour cancellation policy.
###All Cancellations or Rescheduling must be completed no less than 24 hours before the start of the reservation. If you need to reschedule or cancel please click on the Change booking or Cancel booking link in this email.
#Please Note
##- Sailing Lessons have a 48 hour cancellation policy.
##- Pontoon Boat Bay Cruise and Speed boat tour have a 72 hour cancellation policy.
data.booking_notes: #We look forward to you renting from us!
data.check_in_details:
Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your reservation time.
- Please make sure to open your confirmation email or text and fill out the waiver(s) prior to arrival at the location
- Bring the Credit card and your matching ID
- All Passengers and Drivers must depart and return from the rental location 
 - A Deposit in the form of a $500 hold on the card when you arrive
- An operational/safety checkout
data.pricing:
As low as $211 with our Early Bird Special!
Please select a date and time to view rates, rental durations and availability.
data.special_requirements:
- We recommend wearing the provided life jackets regardless of your swimming abilities 
- Passengers under 13 years old must wear a lifejacket at all times
data.restrictions:
- No beaching the boat
- Swimming is not allowed
- All drivers and passengers must depart and return at our rental location
data.disclaimers: Late arrivals could cut into your rental time.
data.faqs:
What are the age and license requirements to operate and rent?
Must be 18+ with a valid driver's license to operate and rent.
Is a boating license required?
No boating license required.
Are pets allowed?
We are pet friendly.
